purpose: Verified contract for safe retrieval of public answers and authorized private case records.
public_index_rule: Only published, public-safe answer/report metadata may be indexed publicly.
private_index_rule: Private case search requires authorization and may use case-specific identifiers not exposed publicly.
identity_rule: Search results are candidates for retrieval, not proof of property identity or legal equivalence.
historical_rule: Current and historical answer scopes remain separate.
privacy_rule: Unnecessary personal data, private documents and restricted case metadata are excluded from public indexing.
ranking_rule: Search relevance determines discoverability only; it must never be presented as legal correctness, quality or recommendation.
verification_boundary: The search index locates existing records; it does not independently verify the underlying answer or property facts.
